data.body_html:
Crossing the Ironman 2047 finish line in Marbella is a monumental achievement. Your muscles have earned a break. Instead of a crowded hotel pool or a cramped taxi back to the airport, treat yourself to a post-race recovery yacht charter from Puerto Banús. With a licensed skipper, chilled drinks, and the calm Mediterranean Sea, you can ease soreness, reduce inflammation, and celebrate in style. Our fleet offers options from €749 for two hours, including everything you need for a gentle recovery day.

Why a yacht charter beats the hotel pool

After 226 km of swimming, cycling, and running, your body needs low-impact movement and cold-water therapy. A boat charter allows you to control the environment: anchor in a quiet cove, dip into 18-20°C sea water (perfect for reducing muscle swelling), and stretch on a shaded deck. Unlike a pool, the sea offers natural buoyancy and a soothing, rhythmic swell. Plus, you avoid the post-race crowds and noise.

Best boats for small recovery groups

For groups of 9-11 people, the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) and Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) are our top picks. Both start at €749 for 2 hours and include a skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. Their spacious sun pads let you lie flat for passive stretching, while the aft platforms make entering the sea easy. For a longer day, the 8-hour rate is €2,299 – enough time to visit Estepona or Cabopino.

Active recovery with a jet ski

If you want to gently engage your legs and core, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) comes with a free jet ski on every charter (minimum 4 hours, €4,719). A short, low-speed ride on a jet ski activates stabiliser muscles without impact. Afterwards, relax on the Mangusta's vast sun deck with a cold cava. The Mangusta 80 is also available in a grey variant.

Local recovery spots near Marbella

Our skippers know the coastline intimately. Popular post-race anchorages include Cala del Faro (a quiet cove 15 minutes from Puerto Banús) and Cala Cortés (sheltered, clear water). Both offer calm conditions for swimming or floating. For a longer cruise, head toward Sotogrande or Estepona, where you can enjoy a gentle sea breeze and panoramic views of La Concha mountain. All departures are from Puerto Banús, just 5 km from the Ironman finish line.

What to bring for optimal recovery

You are welcome to bring foam rollers, massage balls, compression boots, or even a portable ice bath (let us know in advance for safe placement). Our boats have shaded seating and plenty of deck space. We recommend packing a swimsuit, sunscreen, a towel, and a light jacket for the breeze. If you need specific recovery foods or protein shakes, we can arrange catering on request via WhatsApp.
